content.short: Flowscan is a real-time explorer and analytics view for Hyperliquid activity.
content.description: Flowscan is a real-time block explorer for Hyperliquid that reads HyperCore trading activity and not only EVM transactions, so it covers the half of the chain a standard explorer cannot see. Dashboards track daily combined revenue over a fourteen-day window and break down on-chain stablecoin perp margin by issuer. A live transaction feed streams network activity as it confirms.
content.meta: Flowscan is a real-time Hyperliquid explorer combining block data with order book analytics.
